description: This file contains internal implementation of the Ginkgo testing framework, including functions to run test suites, handle parallel execution, build commands, and process test results.

methods.name: RunCompiledSuite
methods.description: Runs a test suite, either in parallel, serial, or via go test, based on suite configuration.

methods.name: buildAndStartCommand
methods.description: Builds and starts an external command for running tests, returning the command and output buffer.

methods.name: checkForNoTestsWarning
methods.description: Checks the output buffer for a warning indicating no tests to run.

methods.name: runGoTest
methods.description: Executes 'go test' for the specified test suite.

methods.name: runSerial
methods.description: Runs the test suite serially with configuration for profiles and reporting.

methods.name: runParallel
methods.description: Runs the test suite in parallel across multiple processes, managing profiles and collecting results.

methods.name: runAfterRunHook
methods.description: Executes an after-run hook command with suite information.
